Russian military officer Robert Shagaev, who commanded a submarine in Zaporizhzhia before defecting to Russia after its annexation of Crimea, is reported to be killed by a explosive planted in a trash can in Sevastopol.
Poland announces that it has thwarted a Russian plot to kill a Ukrainian-American in Warsaw, the first time a Western leader has accused Russia of attempting to kill a U.S. citizen.
The Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and Joint Forces repels a major assault by Rapid Support Forces (RSF) on the Jebrat al Sheikh district in North Kordofan, Sudan.
Renewed drone attacks by the RSF are reported in Khartoum, Sudan, for a second consecutive day, with the SAF intercepting several drones targeting the area.
A commuter train operated by GTR Southern derails near Lewes, East Sussex, United Kingdom, with at least three carriages overturning.

Greece's public health agency reports 110 West Nile virus infections and nine deaths in 2026, including 45 new cases in one week, as authorities increase mosquito-control measures in the Athens metropolitan area.
Kyrgyzstan President Sadyr Japarov announces that he will run for a second term in the upcoming presidential election in Kyrgyzstan in January 2027.
Zambians vote to elect a president and 280 seats of the National Assembly. Incumbent president Hakainde Hichilema is running for re-election to a second term in office.
